title: 第271章 三十年第270章 异象
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
有那不服气的炼气士，仗着自家有几分本事，想硬闯，杨明也不多话，手中笤帚一横，将来人弹出三丈开外。
此杨明虽未修成地仙，到底跟着陶潜学了几十年，这一身拳脚工夫和那行气的手段，对付这些个散修绰绰有余。
如此拦了七八回，来的人便都明白了规矩。
那些方士与炼气士倒也识趣，不敢再硬闯，只在山脚盘桓，日日仰望山顶那片金光瑞气，权当是远远地沐浴仙恩。
各国来的使臣更不敢造次，谁敢得罪仙人？便在山下恭恭敬敬住着，每日焚香叩拜，盼着论道结束之后能有个求见的机会。
如此又过了数年光景。
这一日，天光初亮，山脚下众人正各自打坐吐纳，忽觉头顶一阵劲风掠过。抬头望去，只见东南方向两道青白之光破空而来，势如长虹贯日，裹着凛凛威压，径直朝山顶飞去。
那光芒所过之处，草木伏倒，飞鸟惊散，山脚众人只觉胸口一闷，呼吸都为之一滞。
杨明正在山门前扫地，手中笤帚蓦地一顿。他仰头望着那两道青白光华从头顶越过，面上闪过一丝凝重。这等气象，这等速度，分明又是地仙一流的人物。
他攥了攥手中笤帚，终究没有动。
拦不住，也不该拦。
那两道光一前一后，片刻间便到了山顶，落在石台之前。光华散去，现出两个人形来。
前头那位是个中年妇人，挽着飞仙髻，着玄色对襟长袍，腰束白玉带，面容端肃，眉目间自有一股摄人的威仪。
后头那位却是个矮胖老者，穿一身土黄短褐，脚上趿着草鞋，背上斜背一只布囊，满面红光，笑呵呵的好似个乡间老农。
两人落地之后，四下打量了一番。那满山的瑞气金光，从屋内透出的玄妙道韵，两人尽收眼底，面上皆有动容之色。
那玄衣妇人率先开口，声如金石相击：“好浓厚的道意，这山中两位怕是在论混元道果，不知能否探明前路。”
矮胖老者嘿嘿笑了两声，拍了拍背上布囊：“老夫在千里之外便觉心血来潮，掐指一算，好家伙，两位同道在此讲论大道，这等热闹如何少得了我？”
两人说话间，那屋门从内开了。
小参探出半个脑袋来。
这女娃娃如今模样倒没甚么变化，依旧是两个冲天小髻，一双乌黑眼珠转来转去，嘴角还沾着半块糕饼的碎屑。

她歪着头将这两位来客看了一遍，既不害怕，也不行礼，只把小手往门内一指：“你们是来找老爷的么？里头坐着呢。”
那矮胖老者见这女娃娃有趣，弯下腰来打量了一眼，忽地抽了抽鼻子：“咦，你这娃娃身上怎的有股子参须味儿？”
小参眨了眨眼，把半边身子往门后一缩，只露出两只眼睛瞪着他。
那玄衣妇人看了一眼，已知端倪，并不多问，只朝门内拱手道：“洛水清虚子，携友人南山翁，冒昧来访。闻二位道友在此论道，心中仰慕，不请自来，还望恕罪。”
屋内静了片刻，陶潜的声音传出，不紧不慢：“既来了，便进来坐。”
content_en:
There was an unconvinced qi master who wanted to force his way in because of his own skills. Yang Ming didn't say much. With a sweep of the broom in his hand, the incoming person jumped out three feet away.
Although Yang Ming has not yet become an Earth Immortal, he has studied with Tao Qian for decades. His boxing skills and Qi-moving methods are more than enough to deal with these casual cultivators.
After stopping like this seven or eight times, everyone who comes will understand the rules.
Those alchemists and qi refiners knew what was going on and didn't dare to push in any further. They just lingered at the foot of the mountain, looking up at the golden light and auspiciousness on the top of the mountain every day, thinking that they were bathing in the grace of immortality from a distance.
Envoys from various countries dare not make mistakes. Who dares to offend the immortal? So he lived respectfully at the foot of the mountain, burning incense and bowing before him every day, hoping to have a chance to see him after the discussion.
Several more years passed like this.
On this day, the sky was dawning, and everyone at the foot of the mountain was meditating and breathing, when suddenly they felt a strong wind blowing above their heads. Looking up, I saw two blue-white lights coming from the southeast direction, like a rainbow penetrating the sun, flying straight towards the top of the mountain, wrapped in majestic pressure.
Wherever the light passed, the grass and trees fell down, the birds scattered in fright, and everyone at the foot of the mountain felt a tightness in their chests and their breathing was stagnant.
Yang Ming was sweeping the floor in front of the mountain gate when he suddenly paused with the broom in his hand. He looked up at the two blue-white rays of light passing over his head, and a trace of solemnity flashed across his face. With this kind of weather and such speed, he is clearly a first-rate Earth Immortal.
He clenched the broom in his hand but did not move after all.
It cannot be stopped, nor should it be stopped.
The two lights came one behind the other, reaching the top of the mountain in a moment and landing in front of the stone platform. The light dispersed and two human figures appeared.
The one in front is a middle-aged woman, wearing a fairy bun, a black double-breasted robe, and a white jade belt around her waist. She has a solemn face and a breathtaking majesty between her eyebrows.
The man at the back was a short, fat old man, wearing a short khaki-brown suit, with straw sandals on his feet, and a cloth bag slung across his back. His face was red, and he smiled like an old country farmer.
After the two landed, they looked around. The two people had a panoramic view of the auspicious golden light that filled the mountain and the mysterious Taoist charm that came out of the house, with expressions of emotion on their faces.
The woman in black clothes was the first to speak, and her voice was like gold and stone clashing: "Such a strong sense of Taoism. I am afraid that the two people in this mountain are discussing the Hunyuan Dao Fruit. I wonder if they can find out the way forward."
The short and fat old man chuckled twice and patted the cloth bag on his back: "I felt an impulse when I was thousands of miles away. I counted with my fingers and said, my dear, two colleagues are here talking about the great road. How can I be left out of this excitement?"
While the two were talking, the door of the room opened from the inside.
Xiao Shen stuck out half of her head.
The appearance of this female doll has not changed much now. She still has two sky-high buns, a pair of black eyes rolling around, and half a cake crumb stuck to the corner of her mouth.
She tilted her head and looked at the two visitors. She was neither afraid nor polite. She just pointed her little hand towards the door and said, "Are you here to see the master? He is sitting inside."
Seeing that the female doll was interesting, the short and fat old man bent down to take a look, and suddenly sniffed: "Hey, why does your doll smell like ginseng?"
Xiao Shen blinked and shrank half of her body behind the door, leaving only her two eyes staring at him.
The woman in black clothes took a look and knew the clues, so she didn't ask any more questions. She just cupped her hands toward the door and said, "Qingxu Zi of Luoshui, together with his friend Nanshan Weng, took the liberty of visiting. I heard that the two Taoist friends were discussing Taoism here, and I admired them in my heart. I came uninvited and hope to forgive me."
The room was quiet for a moment, and then Tao Qian's voice came out, unhurriedly: "Since you're here, come in and sit down."
